sentences.en: Baseball or not baseball.

sentences.en: What is different about this sport?
sentences.zh: 这项运动有什么不同？

sentences.en: It's almost easier to talk about what's the same.
sentences.zh: 谈论有什么相同之处反而更容易。

sentences.en: There's a pitcher, there's a batter, there's guys in uniforms and wearing baseball hats.
sentences.zh: 有投手，有击球手，有穿着制服和戴着棒球帽的人。

sentences.en: But there's so many tweaks that make this different from going to a regular baseball game.
sentences.zh: 但有很多调整使得这与观看常规棒球比赛不同。

sentences.en: Banana Ball is the fastest and most entertaining show in sports.
sentences.zh: “香蕉球”是体育界最快、最有趣的表演。

sentences.en: And the 11 rules guarantee the most fans first experience every second.
sentences.zh: 11条规则保证了每一秒都是“粉丝至上”的体验。

sentences.en: Into the stands and the fans come away with a second catch!

sentences.en: That's nuts.

sentences.en: There's sprint walks, so if a batter gets walked, he gets to sprint the bases, and he gets to go for as long as he can until every defender touches the ball.
sentences.zh: 还有冲刺保送，如果击球手被保送，他可以冲向垒位，并且可以一直跑，直到所有防守队员都触碰到球为止。

sentences.en: Also, nuts.

sentences.en: That's an automatic strike.

sentences.en: And there's no bunting.

sentences.en: Oh, no!

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness gracious!

sentences.en: Let's dance!
sentences.zh: 跳舞吧！

sentences.en: You have a player on stilts who hits.
sentences.zh: 你有踩着高跷击球的球员。

sentences.en: You have somebody hit a home run with literally his bat on fire.
sentences.zh: 你还有人拿着真正着火的球棒打出全垒打。

sentences.en: What?

sentences.en: Is that even possible?
sentences.zh: 那甚至可能吗？

sentences.en: There's skits.

sentences.en: There's choreographed dances.

sentences.en: There is never a dull moment.

sentences.zh: 但我理解有些人认为棒球可能有点无聊。

sentences.zh: 他们没有耐心或时间去观看棒球，像我年轻时那样去剖析它。

sentences.en: And you have a lot of history that's there.
sentences.zh: 那里承载着很多历史。

sentences.en: The bananas have an empty plate, a clean palate.
sentences.zh: 而“香蕉队”（Savannah Bananas）则是一张白纸，心态很轻松。

sentences.en: But they can imagine anything as they go, and they're not linked to that type of history, no.
sentences.zh: 他们可以随心所欲地构思，不受那种历史包袱的束缚。

sentences.en: But I think they're linked to knowing what's going on in modern times and being quick and agile and able to come up with different things that will make their audience happy.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们懂得紧跟时代潮流，反应迅速、灵活多变，能够想出各种让观众开心的点子。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I also felt keenly aware of this other major difference in the nature of fandom when it comes to professional sports,
sentences.zh: 而且我也敏锐地意识到职业体育在粉丝文化本质上的另一个重大区别，

sentences.en: which is that delivering on the fan experience at all costs, there is a downside.
sentences.zh: 那就是不惜一切代价满足粉丝体验是有代价的。

sentences.en: Because when you maximize the joy only, you create this set of rules that has nothing to do specifically with athleticism and sports.
sentences.zh: 因为当你只追求极致的快乐时，你所创造的一套规则就与竞技体育本身毫无关系了。

sentences.en: You give people the ability to catch a foul ball and determine the game, but you also rob them of the experience of watching a batter battle his way through an at-bat, you know?
sentences.zh: 你让人们有机会接住界外球并决定比赛胜负，但也剥夺了他们观看击球手在打席中艰难博弈的体验，你懂吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, without a doubt.
sentences.zh: 没错，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Some of my greatest at-bats to watch are a guy just digging in and fouling pitch after pitch after pitch.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢看的打席之一，就是球员稳扎稳打，一个接一个地把球击出界外。

sentences.en: He's 12, 15 pitches deep into the at-bat, and it's a chess game.
sentences.zh: 他已经打了12到15个球，这就像一场博弈。

sentences.en: Is the batter going to get another strike?
sentences.zh: 击球手还会再拿到一个好球吗？

sentences.en: Is the pitcher going to throw a slider, curveball, changeup, fastball?
sentences.zh: 投手会投滑球、曲球、变速球还是直球？

sentences.en: What is he going to do in this situation?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下他会怎么做？

sentences.en: So if you're watching, if you're a purist and you know what's happening, you know what the pitcher's trying to do and you know what the batter's trying to do,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在看比赛，如果你是个纯粹主义者，你了解比赛的进程，你知道投手在试图做什么，也知道击球手在试图做什么，

sentences.en: it's almost like, okay, he knows that I know that he knows.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像是，好吧，他知道我知道他知道。

sentences.en: And it's this chess match going on.
sentences.zh: 这是一场正在进行的博弈。

sentences.en: And it's all going on pitch to pitch.
sentences.zh: 而且每一球都在进行着这种博弈。

sentences.en: I mean, for me, listening to that, I don't understand how anyone can not love baseball.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对我而言，听到这些，我不明白怎么会有人不喜欢棒球。

sentences.en: And yet there has been a sense that many young people just don't agree, you know, that baseball is falling out of favor with younger audiences.
sentences.zh: 然而，确实有一种感觉，许多年轻人并不认同，你知道，棒球在年轻观众中正逐渐失宠。

sentences.en: What do you think is driving that?
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么导致了这种情况？

sentences.en: We live in a time of shorter attention spans where people want instant gratification.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个注意力持续时间缩短的时代，人们想要即时的满足感。

sentences.en: All of that thinking, it takes time, and it makes for a longer game, and it slows the game down.
sentences.zh: 所有那些思考都需要时间，这会让比赛变长，也会拖慢比赛节奏。

sentences.en: And there's not as many people as in the past who would want to sit down for a three-hour, three-and-a-half-hour game and think through those decisions along with the players.
sentences.zh: 现在不像过去那样有那么多人愿意坐下来看一场三个小时、三个半小时的比赛，并与球员一起思考那些决策。

sentences.en: I feel like I've seen other sports trying, in some ways, to do something like what the Banders are doing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我看到其他体育项目也在某种程度上尝试做类似“香蕉队”正在做的事情。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about, like, TGL Golf, which is this new league that Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy are behind that's trying to do a faster, peppier version of golf.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是 TGL 高尔夫，这是泰格·伍兹和罗里·麦克罗伊支持的一个新联盟，他们试图打造一个节奏更快、更活泼的高尔夫版本。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's going to come into all sports.
sentences.zh: 没错，我认为这会蔓延到所有体育项目中。

sentences.en: I know one of the things that the NBA is debating is having one free-throw count for the regular two points or shortening quarters.
sentences.zh: 我知道 NBA 正在讨论的一件事是，将罚球算作两分，或者缩短每节的时间。

sentences.en: I think everything is trying to shorten itself up and make it in a nice little package to have fans in and out and be able to go on to their next thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为一切都在试图精简，将其包装成一个精美的小产品，让球迷能快速进出，然后去忙别的事情。

sentences.en: You know, for me, the thing that I felt was missing, and this is probably because I'm a sicko, is pain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对我来说，我觉得缺失的东西——这可能是因为我有点受虐倾向——是痛苦。

sentences.en: And before you stop me and say, are you okay, let me explain.
sentences.zh: 在你打断我问我是否还好之前，让我解释一下。

sentences.en: The angst for me, the suffering, that is at the core of my, and I think many people's, attachment to sports and to fandom.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，那种焦虑，那种受苦，是我以及我认为许多人对体育和粉丝文化产生依恋的核心。

sentences.en: Knowing that you could have your heart ripped out of your chest is the point.
sentences.zh: 知道你的心可能会被掏空，这才是重点。

sentences.en: And I just think that's not something that you're going to get when the main thing is how many backflips these guys can do in two hours.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，当核心内容变成这些人两小时内能做多少个后空翻时，你就无法获得那种感觉了。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: It's Disney baseball.
sentences.zh: 这是迪士尼版的棒球。

sentences.en: You're always going to end up with that happy ending.
sentences.zh: 你总是会得到那个圆满的结局。

sentences.en: You talking about that, I remember last fall, Game 7 of the World Series, where I was just seconds away.
sentences.zh: 说到这个，我记得去年秋天，世界大赛第七场，我离关掉电视只差几秒钟。

sentences.en: That was such a crazy game.
sentences.zh: 那真是一场疯狂的比赛。

sentences.en: I was seconds away from turning off the television because I didn't want to see the Blue Jays celebrate a championship.
sentences.zh: 我当时离关掉电视只差几秒钟，因为我不想看到蓝鸟队庆祝夺冠。

sentences.en: Probably as Miguel Rojas was walking up to the plate, I was turning it off because I was sick.
sentences.zh: 大概在米格尔·罗哈斯走上打击区的时候，我就要关掉电视了，因为我难受极了。

sentences.en: Oh my God, right.
sentences.zh: 天哪，没错。

sentences.en: You're a Dodgers fan.
sentences.zh: 你是道奇队的球迷。

sentences.en: I forgot.
sentences.zh: 我忘了。

sentences.en: Then their utility player who barely ever plays comes and hits a home run and ties the game.
sentences.zh: 然后他们那个几乎从不上场的替补球员上来打出了一支全垒打，扳平了比分。

sentences.en: And it's just, the pendulum has swung, right?
sentences.zh: 这就像，天平倾斜了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's from despair to overwhelming elation in a span of seconds.
sentences.zh: 在几秒钟内从绝望变成了狂喜。

sentences.en: And are you going to get that with the Savannah Bananas?
sentences.zh: 你在“香蕉队”的比赛中能得到这种体验吗？

sentences.en: No, but you're going to get that steady ride, that Disney ending where you're going to be smiling and entertained and having fun.
sentences.zh: 不能，但你会得到那种平稳的旅程，那种迪士尼式的结局，你会面带微笑，感到娱乐和快乐。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you're going to see dances and you're going to see flips and you're going to see baseball being played.
sentences.zh: 你会看到舞蹈，看到空翻，看到棒球比赛。

sentences.en: You're going to be delighted.
sentences.zh: 你会感到愉悦。

sentences.en: You're going to be delighted.
sentences.zh: 你会感到愉悦。

sentences.en: But the stakes just aren't going to be there.
sentences.zh: 但那种赌注感是不存在的。

sentences.en: They're just not going to be the same.
sentences.zh: 它们就是不一样。

sentences.en: There's not the history.
sentences.zh: 没有那种历史沉淀。

sentences.en: There's not the momentum.
sentences.zh: 没有那种势头。

sentences.en: It's exhibition baseball with the bananas.
sentences.zh: “香蕉队”的比赛就是表演赛。

sentences.en: I have to confess, Jonathan, during the game, the guy sitting next to us had the Twins game on his phone,
sentences.zh: 我得承认，乔纳森，比赛期间，坐在我们旁边的那个人手机上在看双城队的比赛，

sentences.en: which then gave me the permission structure to put the Phillies on my phone.
sentences.zh: 这给了我理由在手机上打开费城人队的比赛。

sentences.en: And after being up very late in the game, they lost in extra innings in spectacular fashion.
sentences.zh: 在比赛后期领先的情况下，他们最终在延长赛中以一种戏剧性的方式输掉了比赛。

sentences.en: So, anyway, forget baseball.
sentences.zh: 所以，总之，忘掉棒球吧。

sentences.en: I hate baseball.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌棒球。

sentences.en: I'm going to do banana ball.
sentences.zh: 我要去看“香蕉球”了。

sentences.en: That was what I thought.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么想的。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's the no stakes with it and you'll be happy.
sentences.zh: 没错，那里没有赌注，你会很开心。

sentences.en: You just may be on a wait list to get into a game for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 你可能只是需要排很长时间的候补名单才能买到票。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: It's honestly been a blaSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Natalie, it's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.zh: 由温迪·多尔剪辑，达莉亚·哈达德提供制作协助。

sentences.zh: 节目包含丹·鲍威尔的音乐，由索菲亚·兰德曼负责工程。
